title: What a Model Is: Weights and Tensors
description: Learn what weights, tensors and parameter counts are, and why they set a model's size.

title: Training vs Inference
description: See how training adjusts weights while inference just runs a finished model, and why that difference matters.

title: Latency, Memory and Money
description: Understand latency, throughput, memory footprint and cost, the four pressures behind every optimization.

title: Measure First: Profiling and Benchmarks
description: Learn to profile and benchmark properly so you fix real bottlenecks instead of guessing.

title: Accuracy vs Speed Trade-offs
description: Explore the trade-off between speed and accuracy, and how budgets and baselines keep you honest.

title: Numeric Precision: FP32 to INT8
description: Compare FP32, FP16, BF16, INT8 and 4-bit numbers, and see how bits become memory.

title: Post-Training Quantization
description: Shrink a finished model with post-training quantization, using scales and calibration data.

title: Quantization-Aware Training
description: Learn how quantization-aware training teaches a model to cope with low precision.

title: Pruning
description: Learn how deleting unimportant weights shrinks a model, and why structured versus unstructured pruning matters for real speedups.

title: Knowledge Distillation
description: See how a small student model learns from a big teacher's soft probabilities to keep most of its quality.

title: Low-Rank and Weight Sharing
description: Discover how splitting matrices into thin factors and sharing weights cut a model's stored parameters.

title: CPU, GPU and Accelerators
description: Understand why GPUs and accelerators suit neural networks, and how memory, not math, often sets the speed limit.

title: Batching
description: Learn how grouping requests raises throughput, what it costs in latency, and how padding wastes compute.

title: Operator Fusion and Graph Compilers
description: Find out how fusing operations and compiling the model graph cut memory traffic and speed up inference.

title: Model Formats: ONNX and GGUF
description: Learn what ONNX and GGUF files are, how to convert models safely, and what Q4 and Q8 mean.

title: Inference Runtimes
description: How runtimes like ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, OpenVINO and llama.cpp actually execute your model on real hardware.

title: Tokens and Context Length
description: See how language models read text as tokens, and why context length drives cost and memory.

title: The KV Cache
description: Learn how the KV cache saves repeated work while generating text, and why it eats GPU memory.

title: FlashAttention and Attention Tricks
description: Understand why attention is costly and how FlashAttention, grouped-query and sliding-window tricks tame it.

title: Speculative Decoding
description: Discover how a small draft model guesses ahead and a big model verifies, speeding up generation.

title: Continuous Batching and Serving Engines
description: Learn why continuous batching beats static batching and how engines like vLLM serve many users.

title: LoRA and QLoRA
description: Fine-tune big models cheaply using small LoRA adapters and 4-bit QLoRA.

title: LLM Serving Metrics
description: Learn prefill versus decode, then TTFT, TPOT, chunked prefill and goodput: the measures of how an LLM feels to users.

title: Splitting Models Across GPUs
description: See why big models need several GPUs and how tensor, pipeline and data parallelism, mixture-of-experts and fast links fit together.

title: Caching and Model Routing
description: Save money and time by reusing past answers and sending easy requests to smaller, cheaper models.

title: Autoscaling and Cold Starts
description: See how services add and remove servers with traffic, and why brand-new servers start slowly.

title: Cost per Request
description: Learn to work out what each request costs and which levers make it cheaper.

title: Edge and On-Device Deployment
description: Explore running models on phones and gadgets, and the memory, power, and privacy trade-offs involved.

title: Regression-Testing After Optimizing
description: Check that a faster, smaller model still works as well, using baselines, test sets, and safe rollouts.

title: Choosing an Optimization Strategy
description: Pick the right optimizations by finding your bottleneck, setting a target, and starting with cheap wins.

title: Common Optimization Pitfalls
description: Spot common mistakes like guessing, bad benchmarks, hidden accuracy loss, and over-tuning.
